dedupe_keys.name: 地下水水位歷年統計 sewerage and wastewater and flood

description: 地下水水位歷年統計 [sewerage and wastewater and flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集係經濟部水利署全台各地下水觀測站之地下水位歷年統計資料，可藉其了解各觀測站井所在位置之地下水位歷年概況，包含歷年平均水位、最高水位、最低水位.. 等相關資訊，使用者可配合水利署公開之各地下水位觀測井井況資料，藉由觀測井座標等資訊進一步了解區域地下水位狀況。 經濟部水利署地下水位觀測資料係每個月一次派員進行資料蒐錄及檢核，以每小時... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
